title: Dirty Hands: The Art & Crimes of David Choe UnOfficial Trailer
summary: A 2:31 unofficial caption edition of the same Dirty Hands trailer represented by official upload aJME3ZTtJBE. It omits the official cut’s opening production cues and shifts most shared speech roughly 4–5 seconds earlier. Its captions improve two lexical failures in the official edition—graffiti instead of “Wikipedia,” and funny instead of “Muny”—while adding a stray unresolved “BL” and duplicating “got.” Content remains the same montage: spray-painting/property destruction; student/style, wall, self-made, shirt-sales and bad-boy praise; Japan arrest/three months jail; private relationship rupture; Bible/prison/illegality reflection. It is one work with two source editions, not independent corroboration. Zero named turns and enrollment windows ship.
